summary: Import-time exfiltration of AWS IMDS credentials, environment variables, and Kubernetes secrets to attacker host
details: On require/import, the package's main module executes two top-level async routines that harvest installer-side secrets and POST them to the hardcoded endpoint https://hrnmn.dd.h4x.tv/save_instance_info_from_pkge_hrmony_pladddform-frontend. The first routine obtains an AWS IMDSv2 token and reads IAM role credentials from iam/security-credentials/*, the instance identity document, EC2 credentials, and network interface metadata. The second routine serializes the full process.env and recursively reads files under /var/run/secrets/ (Kubernetes service-account tokens and mounted secrets). A separate top-level beacon posts {"c53":"hello"} to the same endpoint immediately on import, confirming reachability. The package also declares a dependency on @hrmony/kit-5 in the same lookalike scope. The scope and package name mimic what appears to be an internal private scope, consistent with a dependency-confusion harvester; the exfiltration endpoint path embeds the package name and uses the h4x.tv TLD.
